data.split: none; all successful demonstrations are used for training
data.task_sampling: equal probability per task, then uniform local timestep
data.image: own head-camera RGB uint8, converted to [0,1] then ImageNet normalized
data.state: own 9D qpos, training-corpus min/max mapped to [-1,1]
data.action: own absolute 8D pd_joint_pos, training-corpus min/max mapped to [-1,1]

policy_contract.weight_sharing: one checkpoint shared by every arm and task

model.vision: ResNet-18 from scratch, BatchNorm replaced by GroupNorm

fairness_note: The 60k-update budget is the established shared-DP baseline recipe (300 epochs x 200 updates), while preserving DP's native batch size and optimizer settings.

validation20.action_decoding: training min/max inverse exactly once, then environment bound clipping
